meta.title: Moonpatch Farm — pumpkins, cider donuts & a little fright
meta.description: Walk through the gate of a small (and entirely fictional) pumpkin farm: a cozy café, a red barn full of fall goods and a haunt shop that bites back.

gate.heading: Moonpatch Farm
gate.intro: A pumpkin farm at the end of a dirt road. The gate's right in front of you.
gate.posterAlt: An old wooden gate with a crescent moon on the crossbeam. Behind it, a red barn, a cream café and a dark gray shop stand around a square full of pumpkins.

header.home: Moonpatch Farm, back to the gate

square.heading: The square
square.intro: A red barn, a cream café and a dark gray haunt shop stand around a square full of pumpkins. Keep scrolling and dusk falls: the string lights come on one by one.
square.tagline: Pick a door. Stay a while.
square.board: Notice board: hours, what's on and how to find us

visit.title: Visit us
visit.description: Hours, what's on and a hand-drawn map to Moonpatch Farm, pinned to the notice board on the square.
visit.map: Hand-drawn map: Hollow Road winds from the gate past the orchard to the farm.
visit.drawings: Pencil sketches of three pumpkins and maple leaves.

cafe.title: Café
cafe.description: Cider donuts, pumpkin bread and something warm to hold, in the cream café with the sage door.
cafe.alt: Inside the café: wooden floor, bentwood chairs around small tables, a sage counter with cakes and an espresso machine, string lights outside the tall windows.

barn.title: Barn
barn.description: Wreaths, candles, jams and everything else that smells like October, in the red barn.
barn.alt: Inside the barn: hay bales up in the loft, wreaths on the plank wall, a long table of pumpkins, shelves of jars and baskets, string lights across the beams.

haunt.title: Haunt Shop
haunt.description: Masks, skulls and other things that go bump in the night. The one shop on the farm that bites.
haunt.alt: Inside the haunt shop: dark walls, shelves of masks lit green and pink, a skeleton and a hooded reaper by the counter, jack-o'-lanterns and low purple light on the floor.
